behavior: APG requires role=tooltip and trigger aria-describedby, with focus retained on the trigger and Escape dismissal; its tooltip pattern is explicitly work in progress.
source_date: living document; no publication date shown
decision: Use a noninteractive tooltip referenced by aria-describedby; present essential help persistently and keep focus on the trigger.

behavior: APG defines description semantics and Escape behavior but no JAWS speech result; dynamic description changes cannot be assumed to announce.
source_date: living document; no publication date shown
decision: Use aria-describedby for supplemental text; do not depend on a late description change as the only announcement path.

behavior: APG's hover/focus model has no reliable touch-hover equivalent; description semantics do not make a hover-only tooltip discoverable.
source_date: living document; no publication date shown
decision: Use persistent associated text or an explicit info disclosure on touch; never require hover or long-press for essential content.
